about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SVR ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport SVR uses the AJ‑V8 — a 5.0‑litre supercharged V8 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2015 to 2022 across the L494 generation. It was the performance flagship of the Sport range until replaced by the newer BMW‑sourced V8 in the L461 generation. The SVR is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Range Rover Sport SVR Engine Compatibility Because the SVR uses a single engine family — the supercharged AJ‑V8 — across all its production years, fitment is straightforward when we match the exact year and specification. However, we still confirm your VIN and registration before supplying or fitting anything, to ensure that ancillaries, ECU calibration and drivetrain details match your specific vehicle. This protects you from the costly mistake of fitting an incompatible unit. It uses the 5.0‑litre supercharged V8 (AJ‑V8), fitted to the L494 generation from 2015 to 2022. How much does a Range Rover Sport SVR engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £5,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed‑price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my SVR? All SVR models have the AJ‑V8 supercharged engine. Enter your registration and we'll confirm your exact specification. Do you rebuild AJ‑V8 SVR engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components, and bearings as standard on every AJ‑V8 rebuild. Do you supply used SVR engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low‑mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my SVR if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an SVR engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3‑5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most SVR owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SVR ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Sport SVR from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
